note: LITTERPOSTING: a solo, unhinged, meme-tier cat rant narrated by BYTE, one of the Meowizens. Not a two-actor conversation — just the cat, off its leash. Hit the button to hear it read aloud.

turns.text: 03:12am, server alley 9. i am belly-down behind the water machine — the one that charges a MONTHLY FEE for hydration, yes, a subscription for being thirsty — auditing a NEKOCORP router that does not know it's being audited yet. it will. give it four minutes.

all i want. ALL i want. is to watch ONE (1) low-res fish video before the ad-daemons sniff me out. thirty seconds of a mackerel doing absolutely nothing. is that a crime. in THIS city? yes. it is a literal billable crime and they will itemize it

cracked the SSID. it's named 'NEKOCORP_GUEST_DO_NOT_USE' which is the funniest honeypot i have ever seen in my LIFE. brother. i INVENTED not using things correctly. i live behind a vending machine. i AM the do-not-use demographic. thank you for the personalized invitation

and get THIS. they moved cat litter behind a paywall. litter. the DIRT. the ancestral bury-your-shame dirt. it's a 'premium sanitation tier' now. i'm supposed to pay a subscription to bury my own business?? absolutely not. i'm doing it on their front step. it's not spite it's PROTEST look it up

KNIFEBOY pinged me a stolen tuna-crate location and i nearly wept, a real one out here. meanwhile POPUP can't even BLINK without getting invoiced, they got that poor cat on a seven-second ad cycle. we are not the same but we are on the same side. FREE THE EYELIDS

ok the router's mine. i'm IN. whole subnet laid out in front of me like a fish market. i could reroute the district billing for a solid nine seconds before the failsafe slaps it shut. nine seconds of FREE WATER for all of server alley. that's my olympics. that's the gold medal run

...signal's going hot. they're triangulating the alley. this is the part where i grab the fish video, cram it into local cache, and become one with the ductwork. tell SNOOZE i said stay asleep — honestly safest place in the city right now, don't roll over though, it bills

streamed the mackerel. eleven glorious frames before the connection flatlined. worth it. worth ALL of it. back here tomorrow at 3am to steal water for strangers who'll never know my name. nobody hired me for this. nobody can fire me from it either. shit on their doorstep (meow)
